entity: Destroyed US planes kept valid or renewed in the FAA registry after their crash
what_we_add: The counts: 420 destroyed planes still marked valid, 37 with registration terms that started after the crash, all touched in 2023
why: The Boston Globe (9/11 planes active four years on; a TWA plane uncanceled for 57 years) and AP report crashed and totaled planes staying registered — same finding, same direction. Our affirmative renewal-after-crash counts appear nowhere; AOPA's 2023 blanket extension only explains the mechanism.
